_comment: Single source of truth for every policy rule. Consumed by src/explainer.py (risk docs + deterministic remediation), scripts/opa_to_sarif.py (SARIF rule metadata + line mapping), and .github/workflows/policy-scan.yml (PR-comment fix table). The .rego files under policies/ own the DETECTION logic; this file owns the METADATA. tests/test_rules_consistency.py binds the two so drift fails CI. Fields: id, severity, message (must match the rego deny block), doc (canonical MS Learn URL), sarif_attr (attribute to anchor the SARIF finding on), fix.attribute + fix.value (deterministic remediation; value is the verbatim HCL right-hand side), optional fix_display (override the PR-comment string) and note (appended to the PR-comment string).

rules.message: Storage account allows nested items to be public. Set 'allow_nested_items_to_be_public' to false.
Storage account has shared access key enabled. Set 'shared_access_key_enabled' to false.
Storage account has public network access enabled. Set 'public_network_access_enabled' to false.
Storage account minimum TLS version is not TLS1_2. Set 'min_tls_version' to 'TLS1_2'.
Storage account does not require HTTPS traffic. Set 'https_traffic_only_enabled' to true.
NSG rule allows inbound access from a public source to a sensitive or unrestricted port. Restrict 'source_address_prefix' and 'destination_port_range'.
NSG rule opens all destination ports ('*') to inbound traffic. Restrict 'destination_port_range' to specific ports.
Key Vault purge protection is disabled. Set 'purge_protection_enabled' to true.
Key Vault allows public network access. Set 'public_network_access_enabled' to false.
SQL Server allows public network access. Set 'public_network_access_enabled' to false.
SQL Server minimum TLS version is not 1.2. Set 'minimum_tls_version' to '1.2'.
App Service does not enforce HTTPS. Set 'https_only' to true.
App Service minimum TLS version is not 1.2. Set site_config 'minimum_tls_version' to '1.2'.
Managed Disk allows public network access. Set 'public_network_access_enabled' to false.
Managed Disk network access policy is AllowAll. Set 'network_access_policy' to 'DenyAll'.
Cosmos DB allows public network access. Set 'public_network_access_enabled' to false.
AKS local accounts are enabled. Set 'local_account_disabled' to true.
AKS Azure Policy add-on is disabled. Set 'azure_policy_enabled' to true.
Container Registry admin user is enabled. Set 'admin_enabled' to false.
Container Registry allows public network access. Set 'public_network_access_enabled' to false.
Log Analytics workspace allows queries over the public internet. Set 'internet_query_enabled' to false.
